mission.title: n8n: Breaking issue: Notion Node does not support latest Notion API (2025-09-03)
mission.description: Breaking issue: Notion Node does not support latest Notion API (2025-09-03). This issue affects 6+ users.

steps.title: Identify n8n upgrade symptoms
steps.description:
Check for the issue in your n8n deployment:
```bash
kubectl get pods -n n8n -l app.kubernetes.io/name=n8n
kubectl logs -l app.kubernetes.io/name=n8n -n n8n --tail=100 | grep -i error
```
Look for errors or warnings in the logs that may indicate the issue.

steps.title: Review n8n configuration
steps.description:
Inspect the relevant n8n configuration:
```bash
kubectl get all -n n8n -l app.kubernetes.io/name=n8n
kubectl get configmap -n n8n -l app.kubernetes.io/part-of=n8n
```
# Breaking issue!

### Bug Description

The current Notion node in n8n is still pinned to API version 2022-02-22.

steps.title: Apply the fix for Breaking issue: Notion Node does not support latest Notion…
steps.description:
Hey ,

Thank you for reaching out! We’ve received your issue and are looking into it. To help us track this internally, we’ve created a Linear ticket with the reference: "GHC-4364".

We’ll keep you updated as we make progress, but if you have any additional details or context to share, feel free to add them here - it’s always helpful!

Thanks for your patience and for bringing this to our attention.

See the source issue for community-verified solutions.

steps.title: Confirm Breaking issue: Notion Node does not support… is resolved
steps.description:
Verify the fix by checking that the original error no longer occurs:
```bash
kubectl logs -l app.kubernetes.io/name=n8n -n n8n --tail=50 --since=5m
kubectl get events -n n8n --sort-by='.lastTimestamp' | tail -10
```
Confirm that the issue symptoms are gone.
